# sophosfirewall_physical_interface (Resource)

Configures an existing physical port (or XFRM / cellular WAN interface), e.g. `Port2`. The interface must already exist: creating the resource adopts it and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state, leaving the configuration on the firewall unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Physical ports always exist; this resource adopts and configures one.
# Destroying it only stops Terraform from managing the port.
resource "sophosfirewall_physical_interface" "wan" {
  name = "Port2"
  zone = "WAN"
  mtu  = 1500

  ipv4 = {
    assignment_type = "static"
    address         = "198.51.100.30/24"
    gateway_name    = "isp-gateway"
    gateway_address = "198.51.100.1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the interface to adopt. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `ipv4` (Attributes) IPv4 configuration. Omit to leave it unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `ipv6` (Attributes) IPv6 configuration. Omit to leave it unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6))
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address used when `override_mac` is true.
- `mss` (Number) Maximum segment size (536-8960).
- `mtu` (Number) Maximum transmission unit (576-9000). The firewall requires it to exceed `mss` by at least 40, so set `mss` too when lowering the MTU below the current MSS + 40.
- `override_mac` (Boolean) Override the factory MAC address with `mac_address`.
- `zone` (String) Zone of the interface.

### Read-Only

- `hardware_name` (String) Hardware name of the interface.
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `member_of` (String) Name of the bridge or LAG this interface belongs to, if any.
- `type` (String) Interface type reported by the firewall, e.g. `physical`.

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Required:

- `assignment_type` (String) How the address is assigned. One of `static`, `dhcp`.

Optional:

- `address` (String) Interface address with prefix length, e.g. `192.0.2.1/24`. Required for `static`; reported by the firewall for `dhcp`.
- `gateway_address` (String) Gateway address. Only applicable to `static`.
- `gateway_name` (String) Name of the gateway.


<a id="nestedatt--ipv6"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv6`

Required:

- `assignment_type` (String) How the address is assigned. One of `static`, `dhcp`.

Optional:

- `address` (String) Interface address with prefix length, e.g. `2001:db8::1/64`. Required for `static`; reported by the firewall for `dhcp`.
- `gateway_address` (String) Gateway address. Only applicable to `static`.
- `gateway_name` (String) Name of the gateway.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name (e.g. Port2) or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_physical_interface.example Port2
```
